title: The Big AI Capex Question: Should Investors Buy Nvidia or Broadcom This Week?
excerpt: NVIDIA and Broadcom both rode the same AI spending wave this quarter and landed in completely different places. Which company's model actually captures more...
content_html:
Quick Read

  • NVDA posted $81.6B in Q1 revenue while AVGO guided Q3 AI revenue to $16B, both capitalizing on the same hyperscaler infrastructure buildout.

  • Growth investors can lean on NVIDIA's 75% gross margin and $80B buyback, while income investors may prefer Broadcom's software cushion and $0.65 quarterly dividend.

  • Don't wait: the analyst who called NVIDIA in 2010 just revealed his top 10 AI stocks. See the full list FREE now.

NVIDIA (NASDAQ:NVDA) and Broadcom (NASDAQ:AVGO) just walked into the same AI capex storm and walked out with very different stories. NVIDIA sells the merchant GPU platform hyperscalers default to. Broadcom sells the custom silicon those same hyperscalers use when they want to design around NVIDIA. This week the question is which model captures more of the buildout.

Blackwell Runs Hot. Custom ASICs Run Hotter Percentage-Wise.

NVIDIA's Q1 FY2027 delivered $81.615 billion in revenue, up 85.23% year over year, with non-GAAP EPS of $1.87. Data Center hit $75.246 billion, and networking alone jumped 199%. Jensen Huang framed it as "the largest infrastructure expansion in human history." That is a heavy claim, but supply commitments of $119.0 billion suggest management is putting real money behind it.

Broadcom's Q2 FY2026 came in at $22.19 billion, up 47.9%, with AI semiconductor revenue of $10.80 billion growing 143%. Hock Tan guided Q3 AI revenue to $16.0 billion, implying growth over 200%. VMware still contributed $7.18 billion in recurring-flavored software revenue, a cushion NVIDIA does not have.

NVIDIA's next-gen Vera Rubin platform and partnerships with Google Cloud, T-Mobile, and Hyundai suggest a widening net. Broadcom, by contrast, tightens focus on a handful of hyperscalers building their own accelerators, aiming to exceed $100 billion in AI sales by 2027. Different playbooks, same tailwind.

Don't wait: the analyst who called NVIDIA in 2010 just revealed his top 10 AI stocks. See the full list FREE now.

The Next Test Is Guidance Credibility

NVIDIA guided Q2 to $91.0 billion, excluding any China Data Center compute. That is a huge base to accelerate off. I will be watching whether the ACIE and sovereign AI cohort can offset the China gap Huang has essentially written off. On Broadcom, the $16 billion AI revenue figure becomes the number that matters. Retail sentiment has already grabbed the story: a viral Reddit thread noted "34% of the S&P is 10 stocks making the same bet," and any wobble in hyperscaler capex would sting both names fast.

content_html_zh:
快速阅读

  • NVDA 第一季度收入为 81.6B 美元，而 AVGO 将第三季度 AI 收入引导至 16B 美元，两者都利用了相同的超大规模基础设施建设。
  • 成长型投资者可以依赖 NVIDIA 75% 的毛利率和 $80B 的回购，而收益型投资者可能更喜欢 Broadcom 的软件缓冲和 0.65 美元的季度股息。
  • 不要等待：2010 年给 NVIDIA 打电话的分析师刚刚透露了他最喜欢的 10 只人工智能股票。 立即免费查看完整列表。

英伟达（纳斯达克股票代码：NVDA）和博通（纳斯达克股票代码：AVGO）刚刚陷入了同样的人工智能资本支出风暴，但走出时却有着截然不同的故事。 NVIDIA 销售超大规模商用默认使用的 GPU 平台。 Broadcom 销售定制芯片，这些超大规模厂商在想要围绕 NVIDIA 进行设计时也使用这些芯片。 本周的问题是哪种模型能够捕获更多的扩建。

布莱克威尔热火朝天。 定制 ASIC 的运行温度百分比更高。

NVIDIA 2027 财年第一季度营收为 816.15 亿美元，同比增长 85.23%，非 GAAP 每股收益为 1.87 美元。 数据中心价值达到 752.46 亿美元，仅网络就增长了 199%。 黄仁勋将其描述为“人类历史上最大的基础设施扩建”。 这是一个沉重的说法，但 1190 亿美元的供应承诺表明管理层正在投入真金白银。

博通2026财年第二季度营收为221.9亿美元，增长47.9%，其中AI半导体收入为108亿美元，增长143%。 Hock Tan 将第三季度 AI 收入预测为 160 亿美元，这意味着增长超过 200%。 VMware 仍然贡献了 71.8 亿美元的经常性软件收入，这是 NVIDIA 所没有的缓冲。

水平平台与垂直设计合作伙伴

Lens

英伟达博通
核心赌注商用 GPU 加 CUDA定制 XPU 加上以太网 AI 交换机
客户形态广泛：云、主权、汽车、企业集中式超大规模 ASIC 合约
保证金信号非公认会计准则毛利率 75.0%调整后 EBITDA ~68%
关键漏洞本季度中国 H20 收入为零客户集中度和 VMware 债务

NVIDIA 的下一代 Vera Rubin 平台以及与 Google Cloud、T-Mobile 和 Hyundai 的合作关系表明网络正在不断扩大。 相比之下，博通则加强了对少数构建自己的加速器的超大规模企业的关注，目标是到 2027 年人工智能销售额超过 1000 亿美元。 不同的策略，相同的顺风。

不要等待：2010 年给 NVIDIA 打电话的分析师刚刚透露了他最喜欢的 10 只人工智能股票。 立即免费查看完整列表。

下一个考验是指导的可信度

NVIDIA 第二季度营收目标为 910 亿美元，不包括任何中国数据中心计算。 这是加速发展的巨大基础。 我将关注 ACIE 和主权人工智能群体是否能够抵消黄仁勋基本上取消的中国差距。 对于博通来说，160 亿美元的人工智能收入数字成为最重要的数字。 零售情绪已经抓住了这个故事：Reddit 上的一条病毒式帖子指出，“标准普尔指数的 34% 是由 10 只股票做出相同的押注”，超大规模资本支出的任何波动都会快速刺痛这两家公司。
